title: FX hedge advisor is governance narration, not a market view
context: The Initiate Hedge modal's AI advisor was drifting toward market-shaped language ('cost of carry embedded', 'discount to spot'). User pushback: 'we are not intended to make trading FX hedging — I hope these AI features are not for trading like suggestion?'
decision: The advisor is renamed 'AI Governance Observations' and speaks only to: counterparty concentration on the book, entity/group headroom utilisation, maturity ladder clustering, and policy-gap movement. The cost-of-carry / forward-vs-spot commentary was REMOVED. Panel labels reinforce: 'Policy-gap action' (not 'Recommended trade'), 'Compliance suggestion — not a market view'.
consequences: backend/app/services/fx_narrator.py :: advise_on_hedge no longer emits the forward-vs-spot bullet
System prompt now opens: 'You are a treasury GOVERNANCE narrator, not an FX trader.'
Prompt hard rules ban 'attractive', 'favourable', 'good/bad time to hedge'
InitiateHedgeModal AI block title changed from 'AI Advisor Observations' to 'AI Governance Observations' with subtitle 'Concentration, headroom, ladder and policy movement — not a market view'
HedgingPanel 'AI briefing' badge line: 'Governance narration · never a market view'
